description: Turn a product photo into a finished 1080x1080 social ad image (photo + headline + call to action) with matching ad copy, using AdCreator AI. Provide the product (name + short description) and photo_url, a public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (max 5 MB). Optionally a sale occasion (black-friday or cyber-monday) and the merchant's own offer (e.g. "25% off"), which is shown exactly as given; the offer is used only with an occasion. Returns a watermarked preview image URL plus headline, body and CTA. Free, no signup; limited to 3 per client per day. If the call fails, report that and do not invent an ad.

occasion.description: Optional sale occasion; adds a sale badge. Default none.

offer.description: Optional: the merchant's own offer, used verbatim (max 40 characters). Applied only together with an occasion.

photo_url.description: Public https:// URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP product photo, max 5 MB.

product.description: The product: its name and a short description (3-240 characters).
examples: Insulated steel water bottle, 750 ml, keeps drinks cold

name: make_ad_creative
title: Make a finished ad creative from a product photo
